fact: The DRC settled over $1.4m in arrears and penalties to the African Telecommunications Union, securing its automatic seat on the ATU Administrative Council; the document gives no date for the seat, so its published date is used.

The 7th ATU Plenipotentiary Conference in Abuja formally validated the move of the ATU headquarters from Nairobi to Kinshasa on 23 July 2026; the new Secretary-General is to take office there in January 2027.

The DRC is one of the seven member states of the East African Communications Organisation, and its regulator ARPTC submitted 2024-2025 data to EACO's regional statistics report; no event date is given, so the published date is used.

Kinshasa hosted the 10th Ordinary Session of ARTAC, the Conference of Central African Telecommunications Regulators, at which member states adopted a resolution mandating free roaming across Central Africa by 30 June 2026; the document gives no session date, so its published date is used.
Democratic Republic of the Congo sent a delegation to the fourth extraordinary session of the ARTAC regulators' conference held in Libreville on 20-21 October 2026, per GabonReview.
